mode: Observed public-source responses only; failed or unconfigured sources remain unavailable; no synthetic fallback
externalStatus: Existing public Vercel dashboard; no hackathon submission or public post made

sourceDefinitions.name: FastNear public mainnet RPC (free tier) — finalized block
sourceDefinitions.fields: finalized block height/hash/time, per-shard gas used and gas limit
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Polled once per minute while the page is open.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: One provider view, not a network-wide health guarantee. NEAR lists this public endpoint in FastNear’s free tier but publishes no numeric limit; polling is intentionally conservative.

sourceDefinitions.name: FastNEAR Neardata — sampled finalized-block transactions
sourceDefinitions.kind: Read-only block/shard bundle; no API key on the tested endpoint
sourceDefinitions.fields: transaction-array lengths for each shard at the exact finalized RPC block height; matched block hash, chunk hashes and inclusion heights
sourceDefinitions.cadence: One exact-height block request at most every five minutes while the page is open.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: A count for one finalized block is not a daily series, unique-user count or adoption trend. Every chunk included at this block must match; a shard reference whose inclusion height is earlier contributes zero transactions for this block and does not need a new chunk payload. Only minimal chunk fields and transaction hashes are retained locally for replay; full transaction bodies and receipt payloads are discarded. No numeric request quota or gapless archive guarantee is published.

sourceDefinitions.name: FastNear public mainnet RPC (free tier) — node status
sourceDefinitions.fields: chain ID, sync state, latest observed block/time
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every five minutes.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: The queried node’s status is not an uptime record or a consensus-wide diagnosis.

sourceDefinitions.name: FastNear public mainnet RPC (free tier) — current validator set
sourceDefinitions.fields: current and next validator sets, stake, epoch production counters
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every five minutes; cache the snapshot between requests.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: Concentration is within the RPC-reported active validator set, not all stakers, apps, or users. No historical epochs are fetched.

sourceDefinitions.name: CoinGecko keyless market snapshot
sourceDefinitions.fields: USD spot, market capitalization, gross 24-hour exchange volume, 24-hour change and provider time
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on page load or user refresh only; no background polling. User refresh is throttled.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: Keyless API is intended for testing/open-source/educational use and is not recommended for production or scheduled polling. Shared dynamic limit is about five calls/minute; visible attribution is required. Not on-chain volume or net flow.

sourceDefinitions.name: CoinGecko 32-day market history
sourceDefinitions.fields: daily price, market capitalization and gross market volume observations
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on page load or user refresh only; no background polling.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: Keyless market history is a short contextual sample and can be shared-limit or CORS constrained. Latest partial UTC date is excluded from matched history.

sourceDefinitions.name: DefiLlama NEAR spot price
sourceDefinitions.fields: USD price, provider timestamp and confidence
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Polled every two minutes; provider response is cached and not tick-level.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: Independent price cross-check only. The value is not an on-chain price oracle or a guarantee of executable market price.

sourceDefinitions.name: DefiLlama NEAR historical DeFi TVL
sourceDefinitions.fields: date and NEAR DeFi total value locked (TVL)
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every 30 minutes; latest point is retained with its own UTC date.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: TVL is an asset stock, affected by market prices and provider coverage. It is not bridge volume, net inflow or capital retention.

sourceDefinitions.name: DefiLlama — selected NEAR protocol TVL histories
sourceDefinitions.kind: Public protocol index plus dated chain-specific TVL histories
sourceDefinitions.fields: Top eight non-CEX protocols with a reported NEAR chain balance; dated `chainTvls.Near.tvl` USD observations
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every 30 minutes; each risk uses dated observations, not global protocol-wide percentage fields.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: DefiLlama coverage and USD balances can change with token prices; this is not a withdrawal ledger, solvency test or complete list of NEAR apps.

sourceDefinitions.name: DefiLlama — stablecoin prices and NEAR circulation
sourceDefinitions.fields: USD peg classification, current USD price and reported NEAR-chain circulating value
sourceDefinitions.cadence: Fetched on load and then every 30 minutes; browser check time is shown because the response does not expose a price timestamp.
sourceDefinitions.caveat: A market quote does not prove redemption or reserves. Chain circulation is aggregator coverage and not a protocol-liability measure.

chartRebuildInputs.localGasAndBlockSampleHistory: Raw-response-backed observations are saved in this bundle and replayable offline. They are samples, not a historical chain archive.

overviewChart.title: Daily market and liquidity context
overviewChart.plainLanguage: Each point uses a complete UTC date shared by the market and TVL sources; missing dates and the current partial day are excluded.
overviewChart.source: CoinGecko daily market history and DefiLlama historical NEAR TVL
overviewChart.query:
GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/near/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=32&interval=daily
GET https://api.llama.fi/v2/historicalChainTvl/near

Join on the exact UTC calendar date. Select priceUsd, tvlUsd, or grossVolumeUsd from the matched rows. No date interpolation is applied.

gasChart.title: Gas used per sampled finalized block
gasChart.plainLanguage: This chart records real finalized-block gas observations collected in this browser; it is not a historical chain archive or a fee-revenue series.
gasChart.query:
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":"near-signal-block","method":"block","params":{"finality":"final"}}

For each returned block, sum chunks[].gas_used, then divide by 10^12 to display Tgas. Retain the raw block and observation timestamp in browser-local evidence history. Export evidence, then run npm run replay -- path/to/evidence.json to reconstruct each point offline.

blockTxChart.title: Transactions per sampled finalized block
blockTxChart.plainLanguage: The total is shown only when the returned Neardata block matches the finalized RPC block and every newly included chunk matches its shard, hash, and inclusion height. An earlier-height reference contributes zero transactions for this block.
blockTxChart.source: FastNEAR Neardata at the exact finalized RPC block height

capitalChart.title: NEAR DeFi total value locked
capitalChart.plainLanguage: This is a provider-reported USD asset stock matched to a market-history date; it is not deposits, bridge flow, net investment, or retained capital.
capitalChart.source: DefiLlama historical NEAR TVL and CoinGecko date matching
capitalChart.query:
GET https://api.llama.fi/v2/historicalChainTvl/near
GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/near/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=32&interval=daily

Keep DefiLlama rows whose UTC date also appears in CoinGecko daily prices. Exclude the current UTC date and do not fill gaps.

thesisTestRecipe.title: Thesis Challenge Engine — daily market/TVL co-movement test
thesisTestRecipe.plainLanguage: This descriptive test checks whether daily percentage changes in two selected provider series moved together on the same UTC dates. It does not test causation, adoption, settlement or future returns.
method: Convert provider timestamps to UTC calendar dates; exclude the current partial UTC date.
For each selected series, compute daily percentage change only where the previous observation is exactly one UTC day earlier; do not fill missing values or bridge gaps.
Match percentage changes by their UTC end date and use the latest complete consecutive window of exactly 7, 14 or 30 changes.
Calculate Pearson correlation r over that full selected window. The visible ±0.30 direction rule is a product threshold, not a statistical-significance test.
limitations: Correlation describes co-movement only. No p-value, causal effect, independence claim or forecast is calculated.
Market price, market volume and USD TVL can share market-price effects; they are not independent measures of on-chain usage.
A result does not establish human users, organic adoption, retention, Intents settlement, net flows or protocol value capture.
If the selected complete consecutive window is not present, the result is insufficient evidence; no missing values are synthesized.

selectedDescriptiveTest.claimLabel: NEAR price and TVL daily changes move in the same direction

calculation.summary: Pearson r=0.98 across 14 matched daily changes (2026-10-31 to 2026-11-13). The declared rule treats |r| ≥ 0.30 in the expected direction as support. This is descriptive co-movement, not causation or a significance test.

selectedDescriptiveTest.rule: Pearson r threshold ±0.30; requires the full selected consecutive sample; no p-value or causal interpretation

riskStates.title: Validator stake concentration
riskStates.severity: Context only — no historical risk threshold is configured
riskStates.trend: One current-epoch validator set; prior epochs are not yet collected.
riskStates.confidence: High for RPC-reported active-set stakes; does not represent all stakers or ecosystem apps
riskStates.evidence: 355 current validators; top 10 hold 35.9% of stake in the reported set (HHI 216).
riskStates.impact: Validator stake concentration is a governance and production-dependency indicator, not proof of collusion or a security failure.
riskStates.next: Compare multiple epochs and add independently sourced application/contract concentration before broadening this risk.

riskStates.title: Finalized-block activity sample
riskStates.severity: Context only — one block is not an adoption-risk score
riskStates.trend: One block sample: 4 transactions across 10 shards (10 newly included chunks); no daily or unique-user trend.
riskStates.confidence: High for the returned transaction arrays in this block; it does not measure users, retention or a trend
riskStates.evidence: 4 transactions across 10 shards (10 newly included chunks) in finalized block 224,559,855 (2026-11-14T19:45:02.041Z). Transaction identities are not retained.
riskStates.impact: A block-local count describes activity in one sample; it does not identify users, returning behaviour or application diversity.
riskStates.next: Compare successive complete samples before making a trend claim.

riskStates.title: Liquidity stock (TVL)
riskStates.trend: DefiLlama-reported NEAR DeFi TVL changed -34.5% over 30 days.
riskStates.confidence: Moderate for provider-reported USD TVL; low for net flows or capital retention
riskStates.evidence: DefiLlama daily USD TVL changed -34.5% over 30 complete matched dates. TVL is an asset stock, not a net flow.
riskStates.impact: A sustained fall in TVL can indicate lower reported DeFi balances, but price changes and coverage changes may explain part of it.
riskStates.next: Check underlying assets, protocol coverage and price-adjusted changes before calling a TVL move an ecosystem capital flow.

riskStates.title: 24-hour NEAR market change
riskStates.severity: No configured 24-hour market decline threshold crossed
riskStates.trend: CoinGecko aggregated NEAR market price changed -12.85% over 24 hours as of 2026-11-14T19:44:59.000Z.
riskStates.confidence: Moderate for aggregated market data; not protocol value capture
riskStates.evidence: CoinGecko reported NEAR at $3.0900 -12.85% over 24 hours as of 2026-11-14T19:44:59.000Z. Latest finalized-block gas cost was 0.016953 Ⓝ, shown as separate execution-cost context.
riskStates.impact: Market repricing and per-block execution cost are separate observations; neither establishes sustainable token value capture.
riskStates.next: Add a permitted historical fee series and protocol-level token-economic context before assessing long-run value capture.

riskStates.title: Validator performance / kickout evidence
riskStates.severity: High for affected operators — 11 validator kickout(s) reported for the previous epoch
riskStates.trend: Live validator RPC response for epoch 4970; kickouts are completed-epoch results, not a prediction.
riskStates.confidence: High for the returned protocol fields from this RPC snapshot; one provider does not establish a network-wide failure.
riskStates.evidence: 11 previous-epoch kickout(s); examples: centurion.poolv1.near (NotEnoughChunkEndorsements, 0/43198); cryptotribe.poolv1.near (NotEnoughChunkEndorsements, 0/43198); frensvalidator.poolv1.near (NotEnoughChunkEndorsements, 0/43198); infiniteloop.poolv1.near (NotEnoughChunkEndorsements, 0/43198); jazza.poolv1.near (NotEnoughChunkEndorsements, 0/43198); plus 6 more.
riskStates.impact: Affected validators may lose eligibility or rewards and shard participation can fall. A validator kickout is not evidence of slashing, malicious behavior, or a chain halt.
riskStates.next: Inspect the reason and expected/produced counters, then compare the next finalized epoch and independent block/finality evidence.
riskStates.query: POST https://free.rpc.fastnear.com with JSON-RPC method="validators", params=[null]; inspect result.prev_epoch_kickout and current_validators[].is_slashed.

riskStates.title: NEAR stablecoin peg deviation — USN
riskStates.severity: Critical token-level risk — 91.4% below the $1 reference
riskStates.trend: USN (USN) is quoted at $0.0863; this is a provider market-price observation, not a redemption test.
riskStates.confidence: Moderate — DefiLlama price and NEAR-chain circulation snapshot; its stablecoin response has no provider price timestamp or quote-confidence field.
riskStates.evidence: Observed price $0.086260 (91.37% below $1); reported NEAR-chain circulation $69,854, 0.053% of USD-pegged NEAR circulation in this feed. Peg type=peggedUSD; price source=defillama.
riskStates.impact: Holders may face severe value loss or impaired exits. This asset's reported NEAR-chain circulation is 0.053% of the USD-pegged supply covered by this feed; the quote alone does not establish ecosystem-wide solvency or reserves.
riskStates.next: Cross-check the asset’s actual markets and redemption routes, validate the contract/issuer, and confirm whether the provider price is current before making a custody or solvency claim.
riskStates.query: GET https://stablecoins.llama.fi/stablecoins?includePrices=true; filter peggedAssets by pegType=peggedUSD and chainCirculating.Near.current.peggedUSD; compare price to 1 USD.

limitations: The transaction count covers one finalized block sample. It is not a daily series, unique-user count, retention measure or adoption trend.
Daily account cohorts, historical transaction/contract trends, verified people and returning-user retention are unavailable; no such metrics are inferred from a block sample.
No canonical, deduplicated bridge or NEAR Intents net-flow history is connected.
The validator summary covers the RPC-reported current active set, not all stakers or historical validator performance.

Protocol risk covers only the up to eight largest non-CEX DefiLlama rows with a reported NEAR-chain TVL of at least $100,000; stablecoin prices lack provider timestamps and are a market quote, not proof of redemption or reserves.
One public RPC node status and browser-local observations do not establish network-wide uptime or security.
Market capitalization and volume are aggregated exchange-market measures. TVL is a daily USD asset stock. Neither is net investment or protocol revenue.
The selected correlation is descriptive only. It does not establish causation, statistical significance, independence or a forecast.
Provider access, freshness, shared limits and endpoint availability can change. Successful access does not establish public/commercial permission or an SLA.

replayedChartInputs.note: No network requests. Values are recomputed from raw inputs using the original UTC cutoff. Empty arrays remain empty; summary-only legacy points are excluded. RPC observations are samples, not a historical chain archive.
